comparison.objective: Fit terminal covers to three batteries before placing them in a recycling box, versus adjust and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated cover alignment and press fitting; candidate uses bimanual counterholding, recessed hex-key manipulation, fine collar rotation, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: All batteries are covered before disposal; a bare battery scores zero. Candidate requires two safe impacts and measured lock retention.
comparison.reason: Press-fitting protective covers does not test iterative dynamic tuning, despite shared alignment and force-control primitives.
